$comment: **Classified `grey`, as `docs/mod-roster.md` §3.3 #7 said it would be**, for fullbright's reason: it lets you see farther than vanilla lets you see, which is not purely aesthetic on §6.1's own account. Blindness is deliberately out of reach — that fog is a potion effect somebody applied to you, and removing it would be removing a gameplay mechanic rather than a visual one.
label: Fog
description: Reduces or removes distance, water and lava fog. Blindness is never touched.
settings_description: Settings for the Fog gameplay mod. Each kind of fog has three steps: `vanilla`, `reduced` and `off`. Distance fog hides the edge of the loaded world, so turning it off shows the chunk border instead of a haze — `reduced` pushes the haze out to the edge. Classified `grey`; see the top of this file.

distance_fog.description: Fog at the edge of your render distance, and the thick fog of the nether. `reduced` starts it at the last chunk rather than three quarters of the way out.

water_fog.description: Fog while your head is under water. `reduced` is roughly what Respiration III gives.

lava_fog.description: Fog while your head is in lava. `vanilla` by default: seeing out of lava is the clearest advantage on this page.
